content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad and PayPal provide an interface for selling digital products but come with significant transaction fees and limitations on accessibility. For instance, Gumroad charges a hefty 10% on every sale, which can quickly eat into a creator's profits. In contrast, using a sovereign digital commerce stack, such as the one offered by COREMERCH, allows creators to retain a larger portion of their earnings by only paying a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments. Furthermore, these stacks offer more control over data and product delivery, enabling creators to focus on their craft instead of navigating platform restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators operating in restricted countries, the choice of platform significantly impacts their ability to sell digital products. Conventional platforms often block accounts or limit functionality based on geographical locations, leading to frustration and lost sales. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed for creators in regions like Zimbabwe or Ghana, where traditional options fail. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, these stacks ensure that creators can manage their stores independently and without the fear of account closures or restrictions, making it a robust alternative for global commerce.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

One of the critical aspects of selling digital products is the speed and cost of payment processing. Platforms like Gumroad can delay transactions due to their lengthy processing times and high fees. For example, at 100 sales of a $97 product, a creator would lose $921 to Gumroad's fees. In contrast, NOWPayments provides immediate payment verification at just 0.5%, allowing creators to access their funds instantly without the worry of exorbitant costs. This speed translates directly to improved cash flow for creators, enabling them to reinvest in their work more effectively.
Lower fees mean higher profits — keep 99.5% of your earnings.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of your digital store and products is paramount for any creator. Traditional platforms retain control over sales data and product distribution, which can lead to complications if policies change. COREMERCH's architecture allows creators to maintain full ownership of their products and sales data after deployment. Automated delivery systems using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensure that products are delivered instantly upon purchase, eliminating delays and enhancing customer satisfaction. This level of automation allows creators to focus on content creation rather than logistical challenges.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you are just starting and require a quick setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack at $97 is an excellent entry point. For those needing a more sophisticated solution, the Edge Commerce Stack at $197 offers comprehensive features, including advanced automation and support for multiple products. Ultimately, the Complete Builder Kit at $197 provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale, making it a viable option for creators looking to establish a significant online presence.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automated delivery ensures your customers get products instantly.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
